use std.ltl.{ billed }

input rate: Money/cwt = $25/cwt

require let w = shipment.weight else "This rate needs the shipment's weight"

charge "Linehaul" (quantity: weight, rate: rate)

minimum $90

test "a 1,240 lb load bills at the next hundred pounds" {
  given shipment.weight = 1_240 lb

name: constructors fill sequences, dwell, pickup and delivery
tests:
tariff "s"
charge "x" = $1
test "stops" {
  given shipment.stops = [pickup(arrival: @2026-01-05T08:00Z, departure: @2026-01-05T11:30Z), delivery(), splitDelivery(sequence: 9)]
  expect shipment.stops[0]?.sequence == 1
  expect shipment.stops[1]?.sequence == 2
  expect shipment.stops[2]?.sequence == 9
  expect shipment.stops[0]?.dwell == 3.5 h
  expect shipment.stops[1]?.dwell == none
  expect shipment.pickup?.sequence == 1
  expect shipment.delivery?.kind == SplitDelivery
}

name: a given whole cell carries its minimum and deficit flag
tests:
tariff "t"
let cell = tables.Zones.cell(lane.origin.zip3, lane.destination.zip3) ?? fail "No zone"
charge "Linehaul" = cell.value * 1 cwt
minimum cell.minimum ?? $0
test "the cell's minimum applies" {
  given lane.origin.zip3 = "752"
  given lane.destination.zip3 = "606"
  given tables.Zones["752", "606"] = { value: $20/cwt, minimum: $95, deficit: true }
  expect total == $95
  expect (tables.Zones.cell("752", "606")?.deficit ?? false)
}
test "a bare value has no minimum" {
  given lane.origin.zip3 = "752"
  given lane.destination.zip3 = "606"
  given tables.Zones["752", "606"] = $20/cwt
  expect total == $20
  expect not (tables.Zones.cell("752", "606")?.deficit ?? true)
}

expect.name: a bare value has no minimum

name: a property's given cells hold for every case
tests:
tariff "t"
let w = shipment.weight ?? 0 lb
charge "Linehaul" = (tables.Breaks[w] ?? $0/cwt) * w
property "never above the given rate" {
  vary shipment.weight in 1 lb..2_000 lb
  given tables.Breaks[0 lb] = $10/cwt
  expect total <= $200
}

the test constructors set a stop's location fields by name
tests:
tariff "t"
let legs = shipment.stops.sum(s => s.legDistance ?? 0 mi)
charge "Legs" = $1/mi * legs
test "t" {
  given shipment.stops = [pickup(), delivery(legDistance: 120 mi, zip3: "752", category: Warehouse, facilityType: ColdStorage, requiresAppointment: true)]
  expect total == $120
  expect shipment.delivery?.location?.zip3 == "752"
  expect shipment.delivery?.location?.category == Warehouse
  expect shipment.delivery?.location?.facilityType == ColdStorage
  expect shipment.delivery?.location?.requiresAppointment ?? false
  expect shipment.delivery?.location?.timezone == "UTC"
  expect shipment.pickup?.legDistance == none
  expect shipment.pickup?.location?.category == none
}
